list.name: segment
list.label: Segment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_json->>'segment' AS segment FROM metrics WHERE metric_json IS NOT NULL AND metric_json->>'segment' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM runs WHERE project IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 week', COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) AS time, COUNT(*) AS runs FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;

SELECT time_bucket('1 week', COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) AS time, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at)))/60.0, 1) AS avg_min FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;

SELECT time_bucket('1 week', COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) AS time, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS cfr FROM runs WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(finished_at, started_at)) AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;
